{{ooumb|id=Deprecated_template|caption=This template was [[wikipedia:deprecation|made obsolete]] by the conversion to [[help:infoboxes|portable infoboxes]] in December 2015. It's retained here for historical purposes only. It should not be used on new templates.|image=[[file:dialog-warning.svg]] }}
This is a framing wrapper template used in the construction of infoboxes. It takes the parameters <code>width</code>, <code>BG1</code>, and <code>src</code>. The actual contents of the frame - the instances of {{Tl|Infocell}} - should be put as the first unnamed parameter.
*<code>width</code> is used to pass the infobox's own width parameter to this template.
*<code>BG1</code> sets the infobox color and should match other values of <code>BG1</code> in the infobox. 
*<code>divid</code> needs the type of infobox to fill the div id. Typically it's the source type of infobox, like "Character_infobox".
*<code>src</code> needs the infobox's '''full''' name, including Template: to fill the <nowiki>[Source]</nowiki> button. 
*<code>event</code> is a parameter that will change the infobox to a flexible-width. This should only be used for event infoboxes.

Standard example:
<pre>{{Infoboxframe
| put the infocell templates here
|BG1=333333
|divid=Character_infobox
|src=Template:New infobox
|width={{{width|}}}
}}</pre>

Event example:
<pre>{{Infoboxframe
| put the infocell templates here
|BG1=333333
|divid=Character_infobox
|src=Template:New infobox
|event=yes
|width={{{width|}}}
|field3={{{side3|}}}
|field4={{{side4|}}}
}}</pre>

[[Category:Infobox utility templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
